official_title: Commission Implementing Decision of 22.5.2023 on a standardisation request to the European Committee for Standardisation and the European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardisation in support of Union policy on artificial intelligence

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Register detail for C(2023) 3215 final: Commission Implementing Decision on a standardisation request in support of Union policy on artificial intelligence.
Register detail identifies the final Commission Implementing Decision dated 22 May 2023.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Original Commission standardisation request supporting technical standards for the emerging AI Act framework.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The Commission register establishes the decision's 22 May 2023 issue date and identifies the attached request as M/593. The corrective JRC134461 locator at PDF p. 6 / printed p. 3 explicitly says the request was published on 22 May 2023; PDF pp. 8 and 16 link that account to C(2023) 3215 final. This corrects the retained prior month-only assessment without rewriting it. Article 4 of C(2025) 3871 expressly repeals C(2023) 3215, so the current status is repealed; no exact operative repeal date is inferred from eNorm expiration or the later decision's adoption date. Article 5's literal C(2019) 4281 reference is preserved as an anomaly, not silently corrected. CEN and CENELEC are addressees, while Commission authorship and adoption are recorded separately.
